title: Buyback Absorption Intraday Confound Audit

trigger.hypothesis: High disclosed buyback completion may absorb foreign selling and weaken spot-flow downside pressure.

event_window.note: Repository intraday snapshots; secondary market data. This is not a causal event-study window.

interpretation: KOSPI rose materially while cumulative spot foreign net selling became more negative, so spot foreign flow alone did not determine index direction in this window.
However foreign KOSPI200 futures flow improved by 538.4bn KRW equivalent units reported by the repository while Nasdaq100 futures also rose; these are major concurrent confounders.
Breadth and market-strength improved sharply, inconsistent with attributing the rebound solely to disclosed buyback absorption.

Repository data do not contain verified Oct-1 Samsung/SK hynix executed buyback quantities or a PIT other-corporation-to-buyback decomposition, so an absorption ratio and price-impact coefficient cannot be identified.
contamination_limitations: Single trading day; no independent historical event panel.
Buyback completion percentages cited by AI-A are secondary reporting that references KIND and are through Sep 28, not verified Oct-1 executions.
Other-corporation flow must not be treated as buyback flow.
Micron earnings, semiconductor exports, futures positioning, Nasdaq futures and short-covering may jointly explain the rebound.
No stock-level Samsung/SK hynix PIT return/flow panel is available in the inspected canonical market snapshot set.
small_works: Required review REVIEW-20260930-ULTRA-PARALLEL-V2-001 has no new actions_result or expected_state_verified evidence; NO_NEW_EVIDENCE.
Smart-money registry remains 120 samples, avg net -0.9502%, net success 43.33%; no new independent/purged evidence, so NO_NEW_EVIDENCE.

handoff.AI-D: Persist verified daily executed buyback quantities for Samsung/SK hynix, PIT other-corporation flow decomposition, exact KRX session IDs, and immutable event windows.
handoff.AI-B: Falsify buyback-absorption causality against futures foreign flow, Nasdaq futures, Micron earnings, export surprise, breadth and short-covering.
handoff.AI-E: Design a challenger using verified buyback-execution intensity versus a baseline with futures/global/breadth controls; require chronological OOS before promotion.

next_validation: Build multi-day PIT panel around disclosed buyback execution/completion milestones.
Estimate residual KOSPI/Samsung/SK hynix response after futures/global/breadth controls.
Split completion buckets <50%, 50-80%, >80%, post-completion only after adequate samples exist.
Use clustered uncertainty and chronological walk-forward; otherwise keep effect UNKNOWN.
